findings.Observation: Task completion is lower than task initiation.
findings.Evidence: 6183 calls started tasks and 3520 completed them.
findings.Interpretation: The journey contains measurable task-stage attrition.
findings.Limitation: Synthetic data and descriptive analysis do not establish causality.

findings.Observation: PTP rates vary by Risk Segment.
findings.Evidence: Tested on 2843 collections rows with valid risk segments.
findings.Interpretation: Higher risk segments may have differing payment commitments.
findings.Limitation: Synthetic data and descriptive analysis do not establish causality.

findings.Evidence: Mann-Whitney U test shows significant separation in fallback incidence between low and high confidence subsets.
findings.Interpretation: Low confidence turn recognition associates with fallbacks.
findings.Limitation: Synthetic data and descriptive analysis do not establish causality.

findings.Observation: Escalation events represent a subset of connected interactions.
findings.Interpretation: System successfully contains a majority of interactions.
findings.Limitation: Synthetic data and descriptive analysis do not establish causality.

findings.Observation: Repeat callers are present in the customer base.
findings.Interpretation: Customers often require multiple attempts to resolve tasks.
findings.Limitation: Synthetic data and descriptive analysis do not establish causality.

findings.Evidence: Weekly volume metrics show distinct variances across the dataset timeline.
findings.Interpretation: Call volume varies across weeks in the observed synthetic dataset; the analysis does not establish the underlying cause.
findings.Limitation: Synthetic data and descriptive analysis do not establish causality.

findings.Observation: Call duration positively associates with escalation.
findings.Evidence: Spearman correlation and quantile breakdowns demonstrate higher escalation rates in longer calls.
findings.Interpretation: Longer calls are associated with higher observed escalation rates.
findings.Limitation: Synthetic data and descriptive analysis do not establish causality.

findings.Evidence: Prohibited POST-CALL features are restricted in the ml_readiness inventory.
findings.Interpretation: Safe point-in-time features are available for future Phase 10 predictive modeling.

synthetic_data_disclosure: This project uses synthetic/anonymized data for portfolio and analytical demonstration purposes.
